boards.name: The Classic
boards.description: A balanced maple-and-carbon deck tuned for quiet commutes, easy carving and all-day comfort around town.

boards.name: The Surfin’
boards.description: An ultra-aerodynamic deck and high-performance wheels let The Surfin’ slice through streets like a shark in water.

boards.name: The Rugged
boards.description: Pneumatic all-terrain tires and a reinforced carbon frame take you from pavement to dirt trails without missing a beat.

reviews.name: Danny C.
reviews.text: Sick board, excellent for hitting trails. The custom print came out perfectly. I highly recommend NovaBoards.

reviews.name: Jennifer T.
reviews.text: Bought this for my 16 y/o son. He uses it all the time and loves the balance and responsiveness of the board.

reviews.name: Marcus L.
reviews.text: Hit 37 on a closed stretch and it felt planted the whole time. Braking is buttery.

reviews.name: Priya S.
reviews.text: My commute went from 25 minutes to 11. Quiet enough that nobody notices me rolling in.

reviews.name: Tom R.
reviews.text: Took it up the Canfield trails. Ate gravel and roots without complaint.

reviews.name: Alexis W.
reviews.text: The custom print matched my mockup exactly. The shop crew walked me through everything.
